title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_11309)
clause_1_scope: 1,1 This standard lays down the method for conducting anchor pull-out test in rock and the evaluation of bond strength between reiniorcement and grout concrete or grout concrete and rock. ;[sfofrE — This method assumes that diameter of the bore in rock throughout the length of reinforcement is uniform and cement mortar density around the reinforcement and throughout the length of reinforcement is aho uniform.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Pressure grouting of rock foundations in river valley projects - Recommendations

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
